summary: Wide dirt verge beside Jesmond Road, paddock behind, nearest house about 35 m away.
reasons: Dirt verge clear of the lane

best_section.where: Dirt verge on the east side, just north of the zebra crossing and side street

drivers.seclusion: Grass paddock and trees behind; the nearest house is across the side street, over 30 m off. Opposite side has sheds and a parked caravan.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt verge meets the road edge and is wider than a van, so a van can pull fully off the lane. Stay clear of the zebra crossing from about 12 m.
drivers.traffic: Moderate through traffic, but the van stands off the lane.
drivers.convention: Vehicles and a caravan are parked on the opposite side and a car is on this verge in the imagery.

flags: Zebra crossing from about 12 m, do not stop on it
Low-lying: about 11 m elevation, Cubberla Creek 36 m away
Power pole on the verge near 8 m
Gate 272 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees to the east give some morning shade late in the stretch.
